project.title: YVAPE Platform Build-Out
project.description: Complete student experience platform with enrollment, coaching, reporting, and program completion recognition

phases.name: Student Portal MVP
phases.description: Build /magic student landing page, video tracking, and complete enrollment form

tasks.name: Complete/Refine Enrollment Form
tasks.description: Add missing fields, validate multi-step process, test form completion

tasks.name: Build Student Landing Page (/magic)
tasks.description: Create HubSpot landing page with magic link validation, student identity verification, displays videos and next appointment

tasks.name: Video Tracking System
tasks.description: Add event logging when students watch videos, update Vision database, display progress on /magic

tasks.name: Student Onboarding Workflow
tasks.description: HubSpot automation: enrollment → HubSpot contact → Vision sync → magic link delivery

tasks.name: Creative Strategy & Planning
tasks.description: Define student communication voice/tone, email templates, dashboard messaging, visual style guide

phases.name: Appointment Scheduler & Amazon Connect
phases.description: Build appointment scheduler widget, integrate Amazon Connect for voice/video calls

tasks.name: Build Appointment Scheduler Widget
tasks.description: Calendar UI on /magic, student selects date/time, phone or video, language preference, saves to Vision

tasks.name: Amazon Connect Integration
tasks.description: Set up contact flows, call routing by language, inbound/outbound triggering, recording, data sync

tasks.name: Appointment-to-Call Workflow
tasks.description: Appointment scheduled → Amazon Connect triggers reminder call/text → agent connects in student's language

tasks.name: Build Student Completion Certificates (Cert #1)
tasks.description: Auto-generate PDF certificate when student completes all videos + final coaching session. Personalizable with name, date, achievement.

tasks.name: Build School/Admin Completion Certificate (Cert #2)
tasks.description: Auto-generate monthly aggregate certificate for school principal with completion stats and summary.

phases.name: Admin Dashboard & School Reporting
phases.description: School admin portal with student progress, reporting, data exports

tasks.name: Build School Admin Dashboard
tasks.description: HubSpot dashboard showing enrolled students, video progress %, coaching completion, aggregate metrics, export to PDF/CSV

tasks.name: Admin Email Automation
tasks.description: Monthly progress reports to school principals, enrollment confirmations, escalation alerts (no-shows, high-risk patterns)

phases.name: Parent/Student Communications
phases.description: Email sequences, templates, and messaging strategy

tasks.name: Student Welcome Email Series
tasks.description: Enrollment confirmation, /magic link, first video rec, appointment scheduler walkthrough, call success tips

tasks.name: Parent Welcome & Milestone Emails
tasks.description: Program overview, milestone triggers (first call, videos half-done), completion certificate, optional parent coaching

tasks.name: All Creative Assets (Design & Copy)
tasks.description: Email template designs, dashboard copy, /magic page messaging, certificate designs, student-facing collateral

phases.name: Vision → HubSpot Migration
phases.description: Migrate student data from Vision to HubSpot, maintain bi-directional sync

tasks.name: Audit Vision Data Schema
tasks.description: Inventory all student records, fields, relationships, existing integrations, data quality gaps

tasks.name: Map Vision → HubSpot Fields
tasks.description: Create detailed mapping of Vision schema to HubSpot contacts, custom properties, deal pipeline, custom objects

tasks.name: Build Bi-directional Sync (Vision ↔ HubSpot)
tasks.description: Use serverless functions for real-time sync. Student data Vision→HubSpot, appointments HubSpot→Vision, video progress both directions

tasks.name: Bulk Migrate Historical Data to HubSpot
tasks.description: Import completed student records, de-duplicate, validate integrity, test reporting

tasks.name: Cutover & Deprecate Vision
tasks.description: Stop writing to Vision, make HubSpot primary, keep Vision as read-only archive for 6 months

phases.name: Refinement & Go-Live
phases.description: Testing, training, soft launch, and public launch

tasks.name: End-to-End Testing
tasks.description: Test complete journeys: enrollment → /magic → videos → appointment → call → reporting. Test as students, admins, coaches, parents.

tasks.name: Internal Coach & Support Team Training
tasks.description: Document Amazon Connect processes, HubSpot reporting, create runbooks for common issues

tasks.name: Soft Launch (Pilot Schools)
tasks.description: Roll out to 2-3 schools, monitor bugs, collect UX feedback from students, refine /magic page

tasks.name: Public Launch & Marketing Push
tasks.description: Announce /magic portal to all schools, create tutorial videos, monitor support tickets, iterate

risks.title: Privacy/FERPA Compliance
risks.description: Must audit Vision for FERPA compliance before migrating student data to HubSpot
risks.mitigation: Complete compliance audit in Phase 5.1 before data migration

risks.title: Coaching Model Undefined
risks.description: Unknown if Amazon Connect will use human coaches or AI agents; affects workflow design
risks.mitigation: Confirm coaching staffing model before Phase 2 design

risks.title: Funder Reporting Requirements
risks.description: Unknown KPIs required by CDPH, Orange County, CDE for compliance
risks.mitigation: Get reporting spec from funders before Phase 3 dashboard build

risks.title: Amazon Connect Integration Complexity
risks.description: Language routing, call recording, data sync complexity may require expert support
risks.mitigation: Book AWS consultant for Phase 2 design & architecture review

risks.title: Vision Data Quality
risks.description: Historical student data in Vision may have gaps or inconsistencies
risks.mitigation: Thorough audit in Phase 5.1; establish data quality SLA before migration

dependencies.description: Video tracking depends on /magic page being built
Onboarding workflow depends on completed enrollment form
Amazon Connect must be configured before workflows
Dashboard needs onboarding data to display
Migration must complete before end-to-end testing
